src='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, background))
    seeds = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in seeds)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in seeds)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in seeds}
    height = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(rows-height+1):
        for dc in range(cols-width+1):
            if all(grid[dr+r][dc+c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r, c in shape:
                    out[dr+r][dc+c] = color
    return out
'''
